packageRules.description: Docker base image and the Node version in mise.toml move to a new Node major together, so tests run on the Node the image ships.
Bun in mise.toml and the Bun image that installs the dependencies in the Dockerfile move together.
The final stage base image ships in the Docker image.

lockFileMaintenance.description: The Docker image installs the locked dependencies, so lock file maintenance ships to users.
